companyRankingLists.itemDescription:
The newly created company that helps some of the biggest tech companies—including HP and Google—with IT distribution and cloud solutions leaped to No. 64 on this year’s Fortune 500, up from No. 108.

  • The company owes most of its explosive fiscal-year 2022 revenue growth—97% year over year—to the deal that brought it into its current existence: the merger of Tech Data and SYNNEX Corporation, which was completed in September 2021.

  • Strong demand for data center support, IT infrastructure, and data security drove TD Synnex’s business through 2022, despite supply-chain hiccups and backlogs.

  • TD Synnex serves over 150,000 customers worldwide, and employs close to 24,000 people.
